faq.title: ## Frequently asked questions
faq.description:
Discover answers to your questions about Vinovardag's unique wine experiences and services.

Questions? Get in touch at vinovardag@gmail.com

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide a range of services including sommelier consultations, wine tastings, and culinary experiences. Our offerings are tailored to meet the needs of local businesses and international tourists. Each experience is designed to highlight the best of Nordic wine culture.

items.question: How can I book?
items.answer: You can book our services directly through our website using the booking link, or by contacting us via email. For customized experiences, we recommend reaching out directly so we can tailor the experience to your preferences.

items.question: MISSING Are your experiences customizable?
items.answer: Yes, most of our experiences can be customized to meet your specific preferences and needs. Whether you're looking for a private wine tasting, a corporate event, or a specialized culinary experience, we can work with you to create the perfect offering.

items.question: What is your location?
items.answer: We are located in Kiruna, Sweden, the northernmost city in Swedish Lapland. Situated 145 km north of the Arctic Circle, Kiruna offers a magical setting with the northern lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer. Our location provides the perfect backdrop for exceptional wine experiences surrounded by Lapland's pristine wilderness and stunning natural beauty.

items.question: Do you offer tastings?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a variety of wine tastings featuring carefully selected wines from around the world, with special attention to boutique wineries and Nordic wines. Our tastings can be paired with local delicacies for a complete culinary experience.

items.question: I don't drink alcohol, can I still participate?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer non-alcoholic alternatives for all our tastings and experiences. Our goal is to create inclusive experiences where everyone can enjoy the culinary journey, regardless of their beverage preferences. Please mention your interest in these pairings when you first inquire, so we can tailor the experience to your journey through Lapland.

aboutHanna.quote: MISSING Hanna's expertise in wine is unmatched. She effortlessly combines deep knowledge with a warm, approachable style, creating unforgettable tasting experiences.
aboutHanna.heading: ## Sommelier Hanna crafts unforgettable wine experiences, blending the flavors of the Lappish wilderness with her passion for wine.
aboutHanna.paragraph:
Based in the heart of Swedish Lapland, in the city of Kiruna, Hanna creates experiences that not only highlight the best of international and local wines but also reflect the stunning natural beauty and rich culture of the region.

Whether it's uncovering rare vintages or showcasing sustainable winemaking practices, Hanna's expertise sets the stage for truly unforgettable wine experiences.

items.title: ### Sustainability at Heart
items.text: Rooted in the breathtaking landscapes of Swedish Lapland, sustainability guides our choices. We partner with vineyards that share our respect for the environment and strive to deliver authentic wine experiences that honor nature's balance and the purity of our Arctic home.

items.title: ### Ethically Sourced, Exceptionally Crafted
items.text: We believe that great wine tells a story of integrity. That's why we meticulously select wines from producers who are committed to ethical practices, ensuring every bottle reflects quality, responsibility, and a deep respect for the craft and the people behind it.

items.title: ### Fostering Community & Connection
items.text: Vinovardag is dedicated to enriching our community by creating shared experiences. We aim to connect people through the joy of wine, celebrating local culture and fostering a welcoming space for discovery, learning, and genuine human connection in the heart of Swedish Lapland.

hero.title: # Heartwarming, soulful, local food & wine experiences in the Swedish Arctic.
hero.description: We believe that heartfelt wine and food experiences serve as a bridge to the land itself, offering a beautiful way to gain a deeper vision of local life. Our mission is to create gentle, immersive moments where a love for fine flavor harmonizes with the pristine Arctic environment, providing a warm, sensory gateway into the nature and heritage of the North.

about.title: ## MISSING Vinovardag's Story
about.description:
Founded with a passion for wine and a deep connection to the Arctic region, Vinovardag has grown from a dream to a recognized destination for wine lovers and culinary enthusiasts. We've created a space where traditional wine culture harmoniously blends with the unique flavors and experiences of Swedish Lapland.

Our journey started with a simple idea: to bring the world of fine wines to the heart of the north, creating experiences that respect both the sophistication of wine culture and the authenticity of Arctic traditions.

The serene landscapes of Swedish Lapland are not just a backdrop for our experiences; they are an integral part of them. We believe that the purity of the Arctic air and the tranquility of its vast wilderness enhance the appreciation of fine wines, creating a sensory journey unlike any other. Our events often incorporate elements of the local environment, from foraged ingredients to outdoor tastings under the Northern Lights or midnight sun.

At Vinovardag, every detail is thoughtfully curated, from the selection of wines to the ambiance of each gathering. We are dedicated to continuous learning and exploration within the world of wine, ensuring that we always bring fresh perspectives and exceptional quality to our guests. Our aim is not just to serve wine, but to share stories, create connections, and leave a lasting impression of warmth and discovery.

hannaProfile.title: ## Meet Hanna
hannaProfile.subtitle: Founder & Sommelier
hannaProfile.bio:
As a certified sommelier originally from Finnish Lapland and now rooted in Swedish Lapland, Hanna brings a truly pan-Arctic perspective to the world of wine. Her journey is deeply personal: born and raised in Finnish Lapland to a reindeer herder father and a restauranteur mother, she grew up at the intersection of wild nature and arctic hospitality. This unique upbringing sparked her curiosity about how global traditions could be reimagined through the lens of Nordic culture.

Hanna's expertise is built on a foundation of excellence; she trained at the Scandinavian Wine Academy in Stockholm, where she graduated Best in Class, before going on to achieve the prestigious WSET Level 3 certification. Her passion has taken her across the globe to visit countless wineries and regions, a journey she continues today to ensure her knowledge remains fresh and inspired.

Most of her tastings are held in the warm, intimate setting of her private home in old Kiruna. Built in 1914, this historic house provides a soulful backdrop that echoes the heritage of the North. It is a true family home, shared with her husband, son and two lively terriers, adding a sense of genuine warmth and life to every visit.

With over three decades of experience in hospitality and wine, Hanna's true passion is hosting unpretentious, easy-going, and comfortable gatherings. She creates a relaxed space where guests from all over the world can connect, ensuring every meeting feels like a warm conversation among friends. Whether you are a curious beginner or a seasoned connoisseur, she welcomes you into her home for a journey that is both educational and deeply heartfelt.
hannaProfile.quote: MISSING Wine is not just about what's in the glass – it's about creating connections between people, places, and moments in time.

service.title: ### Arctic Home Invitations: Lunch in the Sommelier's Arctic Kitchen
service.description:
Experience the true heart of Swedish Lapland through the eyes of a local family. We invite you into our private home in Kiruna's historic Old Town, a soulful residence built in 1914 that captures the spirit of a century gone by.

There is a special kind of magic in a meal cooked from the heart and shared at a family table. You are being welcomed into the very center of our daily life. Our cooking is honest and comforting, inspired by the recipes and wild ingredients that have sustained families in the North for generations. You might find a pot of slow-simmered reindeer stew, fresh fish from local waters, or hand-picked forest mushrooms on the menu. As a Sommelier, I take great joy in choosing the perfect drink to complement these home-cooked flavors, but the focus remains on the warmth of the meal and the easy flow of conversation.

**Shared activity**
**Time:** 11:00–13:00
**Duration:** Approx 2 hrs
**Price:** 1 195 SEK/person
**Min 2 pax – max 6 pax**

*Private sessions available. Please note a minimum booking fee for 6 people applies.*

**Essential information:** This is a home-hosted activity in Kiruna Old Town. The atmosphere is a lively and authentic family environment featuring a unique mix of 1914 charm and modern design. Please note that this experience includes the company of our two friendly, sometimes loud, family dogs.
service.altText: Lunch in the Sommelier's Arctic Kitchen in Kiruna

service.title: ### Nordic Wine Tasting: A Sommelier's Selection
service.description:
Discover the surprising world of cool-climate viticulture and Nordic flavors. This intimate session strips away the pretense of formal tasting and replaces it with genuine conversation and expert insight. You will enjoy a curated journey through high-quality wines with a focus on how they harmonize with the subarctic environment. Each glass is accompanied by hand-picked light snacks inspired by the local larder. The vibe is warm and relaxed, a chance to learn something new about the local lifestyle and while exploring award winning nordic wines. Alcohol free alternatives available. Possible to arrange outdoors in the nature.

**Private activity on request**
**Duration:** Approx 1.5 hrs
**Price:** 2 200 SEK/person
**Min 2 pax – max 8 pax**

**Essential information:** This is a home-hosted activity in Kiruna Old Town. The atmosphere is a lively and authentic family environment featuring a unique mix of 1914 charm and modern design. Please note that this experience includes the company of our two friendly, sometimes loud, family dogs.

service.title: ### Heartfelt Arctic Dining
service.description:
Escape the traditional restaurant setting for a seat at our private family table. More than just a meal, this is an invitation into the heart of Arctic living. Our cooking is honest and seasonal, featuring vegetarian creations sourced from the forest or our backyard alongside traditional staples like rich reindeer stew or fresh local catch. Every plate serves as a narrative of the North. As a Sommelier and your host, I'll handle the pairings to elevate the home-cooked flavors, leaving you free to enjoy the warmth of a real household and great conversation. Alcohol free alternatives available.

**Private activity on request**

service.title: ### Authentic Swedish Fika: Coffee and Conversation
service.description:
Step in from the Arctic chill for a tradition that defines Swedish culture. Fika is more than a coffee break; it is a moment to slow down and connect. Enjoy a spread of home-baked delicacies ranging from classic cinnamon buns to cakes featuring berries foraged from the surrounding forests. We serve high-quality coffee or tea in the heart of a living and breathing family home where you can learn about life 145 kilometres north of the Arctic Circle. We will share the history of a town on the move and the quirks of living in the far north.

**Private activity on request**
